subject: FinCo migration compatibility follow-up & next tests (OpenAI-compatible APIs)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@finco.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@finco.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FinCo migration compatibility follow-up & next tests (OpenAI-compatible APIs)

Hi Sarah / Tom,

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) Summary from our side
- Goal: Validate that FinCo can migrate inference workloads to Redwood with minimal prompt/SDK changes and predictable latency/cost.
- Key concerns you called out: OpenAI-compatibility (API + SDK), prompt output parity, latency at 2k-4k tokens, and audit logs retention.

2) Agreed next tests
- SDK swap: run a canonical sample (chat + system/prompt engineering) using FinCo's NodeJS client -> Redwood's OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
- Prompt diff: run a seed set of 25 critical prompts across current OpenAI model and Redwood-verified model to compare token usage, latency, and top-1 output diff.
- Load / latency: scripted run at target QPS to observe p95/p99 and KV-cache behavior.

3) Deliverables & timeline
- Redwood: share a migration test plan + SDK checklist (attached) and a pre-configured Postman/collection.
- FinCo: provide the 25 prompt set and a small service account key for a temporary test workspace (scoped).
- Timeline: kickoff this week, initial results by EOD Tue (2026-07-07).

4) Open questions
- Do you have any locked-down network egress requirements for the test workspace?
- Any specific evaluation rubric beyond top-1 exact match / human review?

Attachments: redwood-finco-migration-test-plan-v1.pdf, sdk-migration-checklist.md

If that looks right I'll spin up the test workspace and confirm the Postman collection link.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@finco.com>

Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@finco.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Jul 2026 12:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FinCo migration compatibility follow-up & next tests (OpenAI-compatible APIs)

Thanks Marissa, this is great and aligned. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Prompt set: attached is a CSV with the 25 prompts (column notes + expected behavior). We included a couple of edge cases for privacy redaction.
- Network: for the initial smoke tests we can provide a scoped service account + allowlist to your test IPs. Production will require VPC options but not for this phase.
- Evaluation rubric: primary is semantic parity (top-1 + token delta), secondary is latency p95 <= 350ms for single-turn 512 token prompts.

One ask: can Redwood run both the OpenAI-compatible endpoint and one of your smaller quantized variants (to demonstrate cost/latency tradeoffs)? We want to see fidelity vs cost.

Tom (cc'd) and I are available Monday for a quick sync if you want to run through the test plan live.

Cheers,
Sarah
Sarah Kim
Head of AI Platforms, FinCo

Attachment: finco-25-prompts.csv
